articles.summary: Tenaris marked a major milestone in Nigeria, celebrating 25 years of operations in the country with the inauguration of its upgraded thermal insulation plant in Onne, Rivers State, and the successful completion of the coating campaign for the Bonga North deepwater project, located in waters exceeding 1,000 meters off the Nigerian coast.
articles.title: Tenaris celebrates 25 years in Nigeria and expands local capabilities with upgraded thermal insulation plant

articles.summary: A group of young professionals from Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) sections across Europe recently visited Tenaris’s offices and industrial facilities in Romania, as part of the SPE Beyond the Borders initiative.
articles.title: SPE young professionals discover Tenaris in Romania

articles.summary: When Frank Qiu joined Tenaris in China as a Global Trainee in 2017, he made himself a promise: he would not stay in the comfort zone and he would always be willing to take on something new. Almost a decade later, that rule has taken him through process technology, production management and, today, the role of Quality Manager at Tenaris in China.
articles.title: From production to quality, a Tenaris manager in China on leaving the comfort zone to grow
